description: Canonical v2 PROCESS event schema for the herdr-fusion-bridge, plus a deterministic observation stream. A process event describes one Fusion process (agent invocation, workflow session, executor run) — never task-board state, which stays schemaVersion 1 in events.json. Every v2 event carries schemaVersion 2 so a v1 consumer can never mistake it for a task event; the validator rejects any other version instead of coercing it.

fields.kind: string, one of exactly six: process.started | process.heartbeat | process.stalled | process.completed | process.failed | process.exited
fields.processId: string | null, required. '' and null are the SAME unknown-process bucket and dedup against each other
fields.timestamp: number, epoch millis when the process emitted the observation
fields.correlationToken: string, optional. When present it is the Fusion taskId the process serves and wins over the adapter resolver
fields.payload: object, optional. EXACTLY { lastProgressMs, timeoutMs } — a three-field variant is prohibited

process.heartbeat.meaning: the process is alive and reports its progress cursor; the heartbeat alone is NOT real progress

process.stalled.meaning: no REAL progress within the process's stall window
